name: @barttech/web-core
description: Shared Barttech web helpers (security primitives, etc.) — mounted as a git submodule (src/web-core or web-core) in each brand site. Source-only, no build step; consumers transpile it via Next. Fix once here → tools/web-core-propagate.sh bumps the pointer + redeploys every consumer.

scripts.test: tsc --outDir .testbuild --module commonjs --target es2022 --skipLibCheck --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --types node safeHtml.ts safeHtmlNoDom.ts jsonLd.ts alerting.ts telegram.ts safeHtml.test.ts safeHtmlNoDom.test.ts alerting.test.ts telegram.test.ts && node --test ".testbuild/*.test.js"
